_comment: Behavioural knobs for the synthetic QC corpus generator.
_what_changed: This file previously also carried category_weights and code_weights_within_category,
listing error codes such as IMF_ESSENCE_EXCEPTION, IMF_AUDIO_LOUDNESS_ERROR,
IMF_HASH_ERROR. None of those are real Photon codes. All code, category and
severity weighting now derives from data/photon_harvest/error_taxonomy.json,
which is harvested from Photon itself — see infra/photon/harvest_all.sh.
_scope: What remains here is only what the Photon harvest cannot tell us: how a
delivery relationship behaves over time. These are explicit modeling
assumptions about vendor behaviour and remediation economics, not
measurements, and the writeup should describe them that way.

vendor_weakness_bias._comment: P(a vendor's failure is drawn from its characteristic weakness category) vs the measured global distribution. Creates the per-vendor failure signatures the QC-Analyst agent reasons over.

redelivery_attempt_distribution._comment: P(attempt count = n) for a failing title's redelivery chain. Weighted toward early resolution.

remediation_cost_usd._comment: Per-failure remediation cost range, escalating with each redelivery attempt.

pass_rate_by_attempt._comment: Fail rate decays per attempt (fail_rate * factor^attempt), modelling vendor learning across a redelivery chain.
